menu.title: SHERPAS AT THE LIMIT
menu.subtitle: Two sherpas, one insufferable rich man, one rope, one Everest.

hud.teamFallSub: The rope did its job… back to the last camp.
hud.summitSub: The rich man wants a selfie. You want your pay.
hud.voiceOff: Voice not available in this version
hud.howToSub: PRESS a hand or foot and DRAG it: nearby holds magnetize it (green ring) and it fixes on release if you reach. Feet first, then hands · optional keyboard · H = help

keys.p1: MOUSE: press a limb and drag it onto a hold (green ring) · release to fix it
keys.p2: P2: Arrows aim · I/O hands · K/L feet · U shoo · or gamepad: stick + A/B/X/Y + RB
keys.shared: Space pause · H help · C recenter · F3 debug

help.title: How to play
help.goal: Goal: BOTH sherpas climb Everest carrying the rich man, who hangs from the rope between them. Reach the summit together (5301 m).
help.step1: 1) GRAB: click a hand or foot of either sherpa (orange or blue) and hold. The limb is now yours and lets go of its hold.
help.step2: 2) DRAG: move the pointer across the wall. Nearby holds act like MAGNETS: a green ring appears when a hold can capture the limb. Only holds you can reach will catch it.
help.step3: 3) CLIMB: release the click over the hold and the limb flies to it. Alternate feet and hands (feet first, then hands) and never let go of all 4 at once or you will fall.
help.step4: 4) TEAMWORK: the rich man is heavy and pulls the rope. If one sherpa falls, the other holds on: move in pairs of holds and rest with all 4 limbs anchored.
help.extra: R shoo birds · Space pause · C recenter camera · H opens/closes this help.
